Hi Samir,

Thanks again for the time yesterday — excited to get BrightPath a focused walkthrough. Per our call, we want to make sure the right people see the product end-to-end. You mentioned security, infra, and procurement will join. That works — I want to suggest we proactively split the meeting into two adjacent sessions so we can cover both technical concerns and commercial terms without running over.

Two quick options (times in CET as you mentioned Europe participants):
- Option A: Technical deep-dive (60–75 min) — Wed Oct 6, 09:00 CET; Procurement/pricing (30 min) — Wed Oct 6, 11:00 CET
- Option B: Technical deep-dive — Thu Oct 7, 14:00 CET; Procurement/pricing — Thu Oct 7, 16:00 CET

If those don't work please propose 2 alternatives. Also, who from procurement should we expect so we can tailor the pricing sheet?

I'll loop Karthik (platform) and Vivek (solutions) to coordinate.

Cheers,
Jonas

Thanks Jonas — both options look close but a couple of constraints on our side:
- Lena (Head of Security) will be in Berlin the week of Oct 4 and is only available mornings CET.
- Our CTO (Daniel) is traveling to APAC Oct 6–8 and prefers later CET windows (15:30+ CET) or a separate recording if needed.
- Procurement (I will add Daniel from procurement) also wants a short, separate conversation focused on SSO/KMS pricing and licensing commitments.

Given the mix of travel/timezones and the number of stakeholders, would Redwood be open to:
1) A morning technical session focused on security + infra (60–75 min) scheduled for Wed Oct 6 at 09:00 CET to fit Lena; and
2) A late-afternoon procurement/terms session the same day (or the following day) around 16:00 CET to include our CTO and procurement?

If you can send a short agenda for each session that would help me finalize attendees. Also, please include a network diagram or high-level data flow for security to review.

Hi Samir — appreciate the constraints and thanks for the clarity. We can absolutely run two targeted sessions the same day to make scheduling easier for your team. Proposed plan: 

A) Technical deep-dive — Security & Infra focus- Duration: 75 minutes (60 core + 15 buffer)
- Goals: review architecture, network/data flow, authentication (SSO/OIDC), KMS integrations, audit logs, retention controls, and answer gateway/edge questions
- Proposed: Wed Oct 6, 09:00–10:15 CET
- Attendees we suggest from Redwood: Karthik (platform), Soojin (security eng), Jonas (solutions)

B) Commercial & Procurement — Terms, pricing, and commitments
- Duration: 30–45 minutes
- Goals: pricing bands for hosted vs dedicated, overage policies, contract milestones, NDA/PO process, procurement questions (bring your pricing/PO rep)
- Proposed: Wed Oct 6, 16:00–16:45 CET (or Thu Oct 7, 16:00 CET if that’s easier for Daniel)

Attachments: I’m attaching a short technical agenda and a stub network diagram for Lena to review. I’ve also attached a procurement pricing sheet we typically use to accelerate discussions.

If that plan works, Jonas — can you lock the calendar invites and include dial-in/Teams links and a separate agenda for each? Samir — please confirm Daniel (procurement) and any legal contact you want included on the pricing call.

Thanks,
Karthik
Karthik Iyer | Principal Product Manager, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
